the effects of phenylalanine (Phe) and tyrosine (Tyr) administration on brain growth in the developing rat.
the effects of phenylalaninemia on the growth of the central nervous system.

the effects of hyperphenylalanemia on the brain are not specific to myelin formation and that the effects of the disease on brain development are not specific to the developing brain.

the developing brain is remarkably resistant to phenylalanine-induced inhibition of myelination.

the myelin sheath is very sensitive to changes in the concentration of phenylalanine.
